# VNMSFX

> VNMSFX makes original commercials for consumer brands. Brandon Adams creates each ad end to end in New York, from the first idea to the final edit, using AI tools in production. 15, 30 and 60-second commercials, monthly ad production, white-label production for agencies, and private AI-ad workshops for brand and agency teams. Site: https://vnmsfx.com

## What VNMSFX is
- A one-person commercial studio. One creator owns the idea, direction, production, editing and sound. No crew, no shoot day.
- Made for consumer brands: food and beverage, beauty and personal care, pet, wellness, apparel and other products sold direct-to-consumer and at retail. Meta, TikTok and YouTube first; connected TV for hero campaigns.
- AI tools are used in production. Brandon Adams leads the idea, direction, editing and sound. The client's product assets and approved claims guide the work.
- VNMSFX's only services are the commercials, monthly production, agency production and workshops listed here. Ad placement, media buying and campaign management are not included.

## Proof (results reported by Brandon Adams)
- Sweet Vegan Chocolate, New York: Easter paid-social campaign, one AI-produced ad plus campaign imagery, 5x return on ad spend.
- ByteDance / Dreamina: feature-launch film made from still images, 60,000 views in 12 hours.
- Portfolio: original spec commercials for fictional brands at https://vnmsfx.com/#blockbuster-spots and selected AI work at https://vnmsfx.com/studio

## Offers and prices (USD)
- Pilot Spot, $2,000: one finished 15-second commercial. A 30-minute call and written creative direction approved before production, two alternate openings, two campaign images, one round of feedback. First-time clients can join the free Season Pass and pay $1,500. The pilot fee is credited toward a Launch Pack booked within 30 days. https://vnmsfx.com/#pilot
- Launch Pack, $7,500: one 15-second hero commercial plus four cutdowns and test versions with different openings, delivered vertical and square for Meta, TikTok and YouTube, two rounds of feedback. Built for a product launch or a paid-social test. https://vnmsfx.com/#launch-pack
- Monthly, from $5,000 per month: ongoing ad production with a results review every month. Starter $5,000 (six new versions a month), Growth $8,000 (ten versions in two drops), Scale $12,000 (sixteen versions plus one 30-second hero per quarter). Three-month start, then month to month. https://vnmsfx.com/#monthly
- Hero Campaign, from $18,000, quoted after a brief: one 30 or 60-second hero commercial, the 15-second version, six cutdowns, licensed music and full sound design, three rounds of feedback. For major launches, connected TV and brand films. https://vnmsfx.com/#hero
- Agency production, $5,000 to $15,000 per project: white-label commercials to the agency's brief, fixed scope and price, two rounds of feedback, NDA standard. Agency Bench: five prepaid projects for $45,000, used within six months. https://vnmsfx.com/#agencies
- Team workshops, from $7,500: private sessions that teach brand and agency teams to plan, make and finish AI ads with their own products. Focused session, campaign workshop or multi-session cohort. https://vnmsfx.com/workshops

## How a project works
- Send a short brief: product, audience, deadline. Brandon Adams reviews fit, then confirms what is included, the price and the delivery date before payment.
- The client approves the idea and visual direction before production begins.
- Each included revision round is one collected set of feedback from the client's team, within the approved direction. A new idea or a changed brief is reviewed and priced separately.
- Music created for the ad is licensed for that commercial and its delivered versions, with no recurring fee. Usage rights, not ownership; a new ad needs a new license.
- Delivery: the versions and formats agreed for the project.
